title: Overlay-to-speech sync validator
what_it_does: Reads a HyperFrames index.html, resolves every beat's absolute start, finds each beat's data-anchor word in the transcript, and fails if the overlay starts more than 0.2 s before or 1.8 s after that word. Can print corrected data-start values.
when_to_use: After placing overlays or cards on a talking-head HyperFrames project.
why: MIT, written for HyperFrames compositions; an objective check that overlays land on the words they illustrate.
